post.caption:
Binary is not chosen for elegance. A wire carries voltage, and voltage sags, drifts with temperature and picks up noise, so ten crowded levels would be misread constantly. Two levels leave an enormous gap in the middle, and a signal can wander a long way and still land unmistakably on one side. It is a deliberate trade of density for robustness. And two states encode anything at all, given enough of them.
